description: A quick, disposable translation popup with automatic Microsoft, Google, and Baidu fallback.
configuration.title: Quick Translation
configuration.primaryLanguage.descriptio: Primary language. Text in this language is translated to the secondary language.
configuration.secondaryLanguage.descript: Secondary language used with the primary language for automatic bidirectional translation.
configuration.enabledProviders.descripti: Ordered services. Automatic mode tests these services; fixed mode tries them from first to last.
configuration.providerMode.description: Automatic tests services at startup and orders them by latency. Fixed uses the configured fallback order.
